description: This file implements peephole optimization passes for dictionary idioms in TorchScript JIT compiler, including classes for dictionary node representation, optimization logic, and analysis of dictionary mutations.

classes.name: DictNodeImplBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for dictionary node implementations, providing interface for containment, size, and retrieval operations.

classes.name: DictNodeImpl
classes.description: Template class implementing DictNodeImplBase for specific key types, managing a map of keys to values for optimization.

classes.name: DictNode
classes.description: Represents a dictionary node in the graph, managing its type-specific implementation and providing optimization checks.

classes.name: PeepholeOptimizeDictIdiomsImpl
classes.description: Implements the optimization pass, analyzing the graph for dictionary idioms and applying transformations.

methods.name: canOptimize
methods.description: Checks if the dictionary node can be optimized based on overlap and non-constant keys.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the dictionary node.

methods.name: getOrNullopt
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key if available, otherwise nullopt.

methods.name: isDict
methods.description: Checks if a Value is of dictionary type.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the optimization pass on the graph.
